classification.difficultyReason: Identify each ogive's total frequency, calculate the quartile positions, read corresponding scores from the graph and subtract. These are routine linked numerical and graphical steps; the six repetitions add no new demand.

content.prompt: Determine the IQR from these ogives.

spec.description: Unshaded green ogive with score and cumulative-frequency axes; intermediate vertices reconstructed as graphical readings.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied curve remains visible; separate teacher answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
Total frequency: $80$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Lower quartile position}&=0.25\times80=20\\\text{Upper quartile position}&=0.75\times80=60\end{align*}$$
Read horizontally to the ogive, then down to the score axis: $Q_1\approx17$ and $Q_3\approx31$.
$$\mathrm{IQR}\approx31-17=14.$$
